entities.summary: The Ascension Convent, also known as Saint Florus in a monastery located at 8 Frolivska street in the historic Podil district of Kyiv, Ukraine. It originated in the 16th century as the wooden church of Sts. Florus and Laurus. Its buildings occupy the slopes of the Zamkova Hora.
